_meta.note: Registry of generated artwork. Prompts live in ~/projects/puente-image-prompts.md (outside the repo). An asset renders on the site ONLY when its status is 'available' — until then it is dormant, so no broken images or 404s. When art is delivered: drop the file in assets/img/, fill in tool/created/rights, and flip status to 'available'.
